sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barstate(f):
    s={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        if n['pixels']<=5 and b and 43<=b[0][0]<=47:
            s[b[0][1]]=1 if n['color']=='B' else 0
    return tuple(s[c] for c in (21,26,31,36,41))
def objs(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>10:
            out.append(('Y',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))
        elif n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']>10 and min(p[0] for p in b)>10:
            out.append(('b',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
print("start bar:",barstate(current_frame),"objs:",objs(current_frame))
base=objs(current_frame)
# hold current state by clicking a checkerboard tile 4 times
for i in range(4):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':18,'col':20}])
    r=last_action_result
    moved=objs(current_frame)!=base
    done=r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over') or r.get('done')
    print(f"hold {i+1}: bar={barstate(current_frame)} moved={moved} done={done}")
    if done or moved: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
